name: guided-loop
description: The loop remembers — recall hooks, workspace status, skills that speak today, spec debts paid

spec.why: The harness installs everywhere now; the loop must orient itself. A fresh session saying continue should be TOLD where work dangles (open specs, worktrees) and pause to ask which one. Skills still speak the retired CLI. Five spec debts are recorded. This wave pays them.

requirements.text: do where <workspace>: scans live specs roots (archive excluded) + git worktrees; per pack: name, stage, open questions, next ready task, revision, evidence age; --json machine form; exit 0 always.
The recall block: engine-quoted lines only (paths, stages, counts), worktree rows labeled with their tree, ends with the ask-which-one sentence when more than one is open.

session-recall payload (dual entry): script mode prints the block; pi extension mode injects via session_start + sendMessage; claude SessionStart wiring verified against current docs (refuses what it cannot verify); codex honest subset per Q-3.
The guard hook and the recall hook both ship through the manifest wirings; copilot stays the honest null.
Skills refreshed: zero retired-engine references in sdlc live text; current commands and paths; evals pass; pause-and-ask discipline in analyze/plan/implement.
Brand-in-skills per Q-2: if bin tokens, brand:set rewrites harness/skills together with the fence; white-label proof: brand:check green after a set/set-back cycle.
§5.3 trust tier helper (advisory: unverified / machine-confirmed / human-reviewed) surfaced in know read + validate info; consumers never reject (§11).
§9 log-format check in know validate (ISO date headings; warnings never block).
stale_after freshness comparison with the injectable clock; status reports stale honestly.
Corpus goldens regenerate ONLY where debt fixes change output; diff reviewed in the commit (contract change on record).
§10 + §8 recorded-deferred in DEBT.md with owners and triggers.
The wave closes through its own loop: evidence rows machine-checked, review rounds recorded, corpus byte-stable at close, closed by human:owner.

clarifications.question: Spec debt §5.3 trust tiers: implement the spec's exact derivation (unverified / machine-confirmed / human-reviewed from  actors) as an ADVISORY helper surfaced in know read + validate info, consumers never reject?

Skills and the brand: skills speak the bin name (treadle today) and brand:set rewrites harness/skills together with the fence (white-label stays true), or skills use neutral phrasing (the harness CLI) with no bin names?
Codex recall: session-start injection is not a codex mechanism — ship the honest subset (a recall prompt-file + notify) and say so in the plan, or defer codex entirely?

The pause-and-ask: soft discipline (the recall block instructs: more than one open spec → ask which one; skills reinforce) or a hard gate (the extension blocks continue-style first messages until a choice is made)?

Spec-debt scope: pay the recall-serving subset this wave (§5.3 helper, §9 log-format validation, stale_after comparison) and record §10 Attested Computation + §8 index-structure as deferred debts, or pay all five now?

out_of_scope: §10 Attested Computation (a wave of its own)
hard gates on user messages (Q-4 default: soft)
recall on copilot (no mechanism — stays the honest null)
